claim.statement: GitLab's current documentation says every Agent Platform feature has a default model that GitLab may update, while a supported administrator-selected model persists until changed and has no automatic fallback when unavailable.

source.title: Agent Platform AI models

limitations: The mutable default and supported-model tables are not exact-release evidence.
The page does not demonstrate which model served any Developer Flow request.
unknowns: The effective model, provider endpoint, checkpoint, routing, reasoning parameters and change time are unknown.
Self-Managed self-hosted model compatibility and Dedicated rollout details for this surface are unresolved.

relationships.note: The current rolling model policy and tables are not projected into GitLab 18.8.
